title: Robotic Reagent Mixer with Gear-Driven Valves
description: A chemistry lab robot operates a gear-driven valve system controlling three reagent pipelines that feed into a central reaction flask. The user must configure gear ratios to set precise flow rates, command the robot arm to open/close valves in the correct sequence, and maintain conservation of total fluid volume across all vessels. Undo/redo support lets the user backtrack through multi-step mixing procedures.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing an interactive 3D chemistry lab scene. Load 'shared_assets/gears.glb' and 'shared_assets/robot.glb' using GLTFLoader.

SCENE SETUP: Place a lab bench at center. Position the robot model on the left side as a lab assistant. Arrange three instances of the gears model along the back of the bench, each representing a valve controller for a reagent pipeline (red, blue, green). A transparent central flask (CylinderGeometry with MeshPhysicalMaterial, transmission=0.8) sits at the center receiving fluids.

INTERACTION STEPS (10-14 total): (1-3) Click each gear assembly to cycle its ratio through 3 settings (low/medium/high flow), gears visually rotate to reflect ratio. (4-6) Click the robot to command it to actuate each valve — the robot arm animates toward the selected gear, toggling the valve open/closed. (7-9) Once valves are open, fluid levels animate in three source cylinders (decreasing) and the central flask (increasing), enforcing conservation of total volume: sum of all vessels stays constant at 1000mL. Display numeric readouts as HTML overlays. (10-12) User adjusts gear ratios mid-flow to hit a target mixture ratio displayed on screen (e.g., 2:1:3 red:blue:green). (13-14) User can fine-tune by closing a valve and reopening at a different rate.

UNDO/REDO: Maintain a state history stack. Pressing 'Z' undoes the last action (valve toggle or gear ratio change), 'Y' redoes. Each undo restores fluid levels, gear positions, and valve states exactly.

MULTI-INPUT COUPLING: Changing a gear ratio while a valve is open immediately affects flow rate, altering the mixture in real time. The robot must be commanded to a valve before it can be toggled.

CAMERA & LIGHTING: OrbitControls, PerspectiveCamera at (0,4,6) looking at origin. Add HemisphereLight plus two DirectionalLights for lab ambiance. Add a subtle grid floor. Use raycasting for click detection on gears and robot. Show a target ratio panel and current ratio panel as HTML overlays with styled divs.
